<Heading
  as={"h1"}

  children={"Renew every open member's task lease (LeaseTogether)"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/work-batches/{batchId}/lease-renewals"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The batch's lease is the union of its open members' task leases (ADR 0063's LeaseTogether policy): one call renews every still-open stop, so later stops of a long walk cannot expire mid-walk. Completed members are not renewed; detached members are gone (the sweep already returned them to the pool).

  as={"h2"}
